name: stripe
description: Manage Stripe payments, subscriptions, customers, and invoices via the official Stripe MCP server.

connection.instructions:
Create a restricted API key in your Stripe Dashboard to limit agent access to only the permissions it needs.

1. Go to https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys
2. Click "Create restricted key".
3. Grant the required permissions (Customers, Invoices, Payment Intents, Subscriptions, etc.).
4. Copy the key and paste it below.
